name: Claude Design (canvas artifact type)
what: A canvas of live HTML artboards that a person edits by hand: direction boards, mood boards, mockups, landing-page comps, posters, social and print pieces, infographics, storyboards, diagrams and clickable prototypes. It installs brand tokens from a Design System artifact, exports PDF and PNG, and hands a design to partner apps through Send to.
install: No install line. Artifacts and the Design template must be on for the claude.ai account; on Team and Enterprise an organization Owner enables them in organization settings. In Claude Code, sign in with /login and a claude.ai account.
firstCall: Artifact quickstart with intent 'design' when the host offers it, else an Artifact types list, to get the type link; then read the type's SKILL.md that the create call returns
evidenceNote: Artifact read calls on the type's SKILL.md and its reference files (format, craft, diagrams, print, shaders, design system components, make-from-this, view state) succeeded. File listings and canvas.json of four existing canvases were read. Public Help Center, product posts and Claude Code docs were read. NOT exercised: creating a canvas, writing an artboard, any export, Send to, any partner import tool. No per-call credits; work draws from the shared plan usage pool. With no artifacts in the session the fallback is local HTML, which has no catalog id.
